headline: Product Designer | Patient and clinician products, design systems, accessibility
summary: Product designer with 8+ years of experience, from a Lille web agency to a Lyon health-tech scale-up: research, flows and prototypes, a design system used by 4 squads, and 3 products brought to WCAG 2.1 AA. Bilingual FR/EN.
strengths: **Research to handoff**: patient portal and clinician app designed end to end at Hexalab Santé
**Design systems**: Pulse, from tokens to Storybook documentation, used by 4 product squads at Hexalab Santé
**Measured outcomes**: checkout conversion +18% at Orbital Studio, app rating 3.2 to 4.4 at Kerno Mobility

bullets: Designed the **patient portal and clinician web app** (appointments, results, messaging), from research to developer handoff
Built **Pulse, the design system** (tokens, components, Storybook and Zeroheight documentation), used by 4 product squads
Ran **120+ usability sessions** with patients, nurses and doctors, in French and English
Brought **3 products to WCAG 2.1 AA** with the front-end team: contrast, keyboard paths, screen-reader testing
Designed a **retail bank's mobile app** (onboarding, transfers, card controls) with the client's product team
Redesigned an **e-commerce checkout**: conversion rose by 18% in the month after release
Facilitated **14 design sprints** with clients, from problem framing to tested prototype
Designed the **commuter ticketing app** (tickets, passes, real-time disruptions) for iOS and Android
Led the **research with commuters**: 40 interviews, diary studies, in-station observation
Rebuilt the **purchase flow**: the app-store rating went from 3.2 to 4.4 over a year
Integrated designs in **HTML and CSS** for about 30 WordPress and Webflow sites, responsive and tested on real devices
